main_body: Steampunk workshop: a large corrugated-metal hip roof (rows ~28-90) over a brick wall (rows ~94-126) with arched windows, a riveted double door and copper pipes
top_band: Blue-grey corrugated roof slope with a ridge and skylight strip, rows ~28-90; a lighter ridge cap sits at the top (rows ~28-32)
evidence: Reading down the centre column: the dark ridge and skylight band, then a long roof slope of grey-blue corrugated metal, then an orange eave line at rows 91-93. Directly beneath it a dark shadow row sits above the brick wall. The roof is a large, clearly visible top surface, like the reference house roofs, and the wall below is a separate vertical face. The windows have dark inner frames and the door has a framed, inset panel with a lintel. No isometric side face is drawn.

style.evidence: The roof carries a multi-step grey-blue ramp with corrugation lines, rust dots, glass diagonals and a two-tone gradient. The brick chimney and wall have per-brick variation, and the lit windows are speckled. Outlines are dark tinted tones (dark brown beside brick, dark teal beside metal), not pure black. Tile density is comparable to the references, and no large flat fills stand out.
